contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C ALLECTVS P F AVG ; R/ VIRTVS AVG

A Roman copper-alloy Q-radiate of Allectus (293-296). (Reece period 14), mintmark London QC. VIRTUS AVG reverse type, galley rowing left. As RIC V.2, p. 563, no. 55. Obverse description: Radiate and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP C ALLECTVS P F AVG. Reverse description: Galley left. Reverse inscription: VIRTVS AVG. Diameter: 18.26 mm; Thickness: 1.77 mm; Weight: 2.47g
